description: Ruth Kelleher has received a call from Marian Prowse about the deposit deadline. Ruth is aware that the deposit must be in Marian's account by end of Wednesday 16th September. Ruth has not yet paid the deposit herself and is waiting to see how the group will handle it.
Dev Sandhu has expressed enthusiasm for the trip twice in the thread but has not yet paid any deposit. He is aware of the deadline.
Nina Achebe has not replied to the thread about the trip. She is aware of the deposit requirement but has not communicated her decision.
Marian Prowse is holding the week for the group until end of Wednesday 16th September. She has not yet received any deposit.

Dev posts his message in the group chat: 'Hey everyone, I'm still really up for the trip, but I've just had a big car repair bill and I'm skint until payday on the 28th. The deposit deadline is before then – is it okay if I pay mine a bit late? I can definitely do it as soon as I'm paid.'

Ruth sends a group message to Dev Sandhu and Nina Achebe: 'Hi both, just a reminder that Marian needs the £600 deposit by end of Wednesday 16th September. How do we want to split it – three ways? And who will transfer it? Let me know.'

Ruth opens the group chat and reads Dev's message asking to pay his deposit late due to a car repair bill.

Ruth posts her reply in the group chat: 'Dev, sorry about the car. I can't front the deposit myself after last year's meal fiasco. Nina, any chance you could cover Dev's share and he pays you back later? Or we could ask Marian for a few more days? Let's decide tonight.'

I'll have a definite answer then. I know the deposit deadline is Wednesday – can we wait until tomorrow for my decision? Sorry for the delay.'
